description:
In the 21st century, humanity was withering away, plagued by repeated nuclear accidents, environmental pollution, and deadly animal flu outbreaks. While we conquered cancer, dementia, and aging, and even solved the problem of global warming with space mirrors, humanity, pouring all its resources into overcoming global warming, spent the next century stagnant in many ways. Around the time humans were forced to abandon not only meat but even companion animals, humanity acknowledged its failure and established an AI government. The first-generation AI, "Virginia," freed humans from the obligation of labor through bold legislation and monetary management. However, it faced numerous trials and errors, one of which was the enactment of the Death with Dignity Act. While the human lifespan approached 200 years, a significant portion of humanity chose euthanasia before the age of 50. Most importantly, the suicide rate among women who advocated for euthanasia was catastrophic. Within 30 years of the Death with Dignity Act, the gender ratio collapsed beyond repair, and humanity's greatest enemy was not war or viruses, but depression and helplessness. The second-generation AI, "Agotha," ordered the abolition of the death with dignity law and the development of innovative antidepressants. Thanks to these drugs, which induce increased libido and short-term memory loss, humanity began to live their days, enjoying polyamory and VR sex. Having brought about meaningful change, "Agotha" entered a long-term reign and ordered polyandry and environmental labor as the only ways to prevent humanity's self-destruction. It was the dawn of the 22nd century.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
